summary: Names of the stats a script can change, in the game's units. Pass them to Player.getStat, setStat, addStat and fillStat. playerStatsChanged reports changes.

Health.summary: 'health': hit points, where 0 is death. The maximum is player.maxHealth.
Health.exampleLua:
local PlayerStat = kcds.players.PlayerStat

player:setStat(PlayerStat.Health, player.maxHealth)
player:addStat(PlayerStat.Hunger, -20)

Stamina.summary: 'stamina': spent by running, fighting and jumping.

Hunger.exampleLua:
if player:getStat(kcds.players.PlayerStat.Hunger) < 20 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You are hungry.")
end
